items.title: La regola dipende dalla lunghezza
items.html:
Aggettivi corti (una sillaba):
comparativo -er + than → tall→taller than
superlativo the -est → the tallest

Aggettivi lunghi (due sillabe o più):
comparativo more … than → more expensive than
superlativo the most … → the most expensive

Irregolari: good → better → the best  ·  bad → worse → the worst  ·  far → further → the furthest

Uguali: as … as → as tall as

items.title: Due trappole
items.html:
• Non si mettono insieme: more taller è sbagliato. O -er, o more.
• Nel comparativo ci vuole than, non that.

items.prompt: This book is ___ the other one.
Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
This exercise is ___ the last one.
That was ___ day of my life.
items.why: bad fa worse e the worst.
Aggettivi corti che finiscono con vocale + consonante raddoppiano la consonante: bigger.
La y finale diventa i: happier.
Per dire che sono uguali: as + aggettivo + as.

options: My bike is faster than yours.
My bike is more faster than yours.
My bike is more fast than yours.
My bike is fastest than yours.
items.answer: My bike is faster than yours.
items.why: Un solo comparativo per volta: faster, non more faster.

options: She is the most intelligent student in the class.
She is the intelligentest student in the class.
She is most intelligent student in the class.
She is the more intelligent student in the class.
items.answer: She is the most intelligent student in the class.
items.why: Aggettivo lungo: the most + aggettivo. Il the non si può togliere.

items.prompt: Il treno è più veloce dell'autobus.
options: The train is faster than the bus.
The train is more fast than the bus.
The train is the fastest than the bus.
The train is faster that the bus.
items.answer: The train is faster than the bus.

items.prompt: È il ristorante più caro della città.
options: It's the most expensive restaurant in the city.
It's the more expensive restaurant in the city.
It's the expensivest restaurant in the city.
It's most expensive restaurant of the city.
items.answer: It's the most expensive restaurant in the city.
items.why: Aggettivo lungo, superlativo: the most expensive. Dopo il superlativo si usa in, non of.
